title: Chapter 583 - The Anger Of A Sovereign Lord

Chapter 583 - The Anger Of A Sovereign Lord

Chapter 583 - The Anger of a Sovereign Lord

The death of the woman in the black veil made the expression of the male change dramatically.

The tide had turned way too fast.

No one could have imagined that Zhao Feng would come back so fast and use the Blade of Purple Destruction the instant he appeared. Even the skeletal Division Leader had an incredulous expression.

The person that Zhao Feng killed was a late-stage Small Origin Core Realm.

Truthfully, the Blade of Purple Destruction could only threaten those at the early stages of the Small Origin Core Realm, and while it also posed a threat to those at the middle-stage Small Origin Core Realm such as the skeletal Division Leader and the fierce-looking man, the threat would dramatically decrease if they were ready for it.

However, the danger it posed to a late-stage Small Origin Core Realm was very limited.

The main reason Zhao Feng succeeded was due to the combination of the Wings of Wind and Lightning and the Blade of Purple Destruction.

Firstly, during the process of travelling over, the Blade of Purple Destruction was already condensed. Although he had only comprehended 20-30% of the Purple Destruction Wind Lightning, it had merged with the aura from the Ancient Dream Realm, so the pure power of Destruction had surpassed even the Wind Lightning Emperor when he was at the same cultivation as Zhao Feng.

Secondly, the Wings of Wind and Lightning had the ability to increase the power of Wind Lightning techniques. In addition, Zhao Feng’s attack speed was extremely fast with the support of the Wings of Wind and Lightning.

The other half of the reason for the woman’s death was ignorance, and the fact that she had already been severely injured beforehand by the skeletal Division Leader after her Dark Jade Skeleton was defeated by Zhao Feng.

In the air, the clash of the two Sovereign Lords caused soul-shaking explosions.

“What…?”

The situation below made the expression of the Metal Triangle Pirate captain change.

One of the main reasons that he dared to threaten the elder in the shirt was due to the fact he had powerful subordinates, and now this advantage was destroyed by Zhao Feng.

“Hahaha…. Looks like I was correct in choosing that brat.”

The Third Elder from the Gan Cloud Pavilion had a red face and laughed as he became more aggressive in his attacks.

He couldn’t help but think that he had gambled correctly. Before they teamed up, the elder only sensed that Zhao Feng was not simple. He didn’t think that Zhao Feng would give him such a big surprise.

With the death of the black-veiled woman, the result was already clear.

“Purple Destruction Wind Lightning Whip!”

Zhao Feng circulated his half-step True Yuan and condensed a faint purple whip of wind and lightning, which radiated an aura of Destruction as it flashed throughout the air.

The Purple Destruction Wind Lightning Whip attacked the male Sovereign from behind, forming a pincer attack with the skeletal Division Leader.

“Zhe zhe zhe….”

The skeletal Division Leader laughed and increased his offense, forcing the nasty-looking male to cough out blood.

The nasty-looking man started to panic. He wasn’t even the skeletal Division Leader’s match in a one-on-one, let alone now.

Zhao Feng’s assistance soon forced the male into despair.

Whoosh!

The Purple Destruction Wind Lightning Whip sealed all the male’s escape routes. He fell into the whip of Wind Lightning, then was cut in two by the flaming bone giant that was the skeletal Division Leader.

“Hahahaha! Good job!”

The elder in the air laughed gloatingly, whereas the expression of the Metal Triangle Pirate captain was filled with cold killing intent as he looked at Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader.

Because of those two, not only would he not get any part of the whale, he also had heavy losses.

Sou! Sou!

Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader then charged toward the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates in the air after killing the two Sovereigns.

“You’re courting death!”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates snickered coldly as he released his Great Origin Core Realm aura. The aura of a Great Origin Core Realm would restrict and limit the power of normal Sovereigns.

“Ice Imperial Spear!”

Zhao Feng summoned the true version of his Ice Imperial Spear. An ancient blue spear that glinted beautifully in the light appeared.

Now that Zhao Feng’s bloodline had become much purer on top of his new half-step Origin Core Realm cultivation, he could easily summon the true version of the Ice Imperial Spear.

Furthermore, its strength had started to awaken after absorbing the aura of the Ancient Dream Realm.

Bam~~~~~

The Ice Imperial Spear released a forbidden cold power that froze all physical objects nearby.

Wham! Wham!

The purposely created shockwave from the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates was also turned into ice by the Ice Imperial Spear, which then shattered into pieces.

Without a doubt, after breaking through, Zhao Feng’s strength had risen dramatically. He could now use more of the Ice Imperial Spear’s power.

“Go!”

Zhao Feng pointed, and a phantom of the spear shot out toward the Metal Triangle Pirate captain, causing the area to freeze.

“Limitless Sky Extreme Demonic Stab!”

The skeletal Division Leader also stabbed out with its Earth-Grade weapon, which seemed to break through space as it attacked the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates from the other side.

Even a Great Origin Core Realm couldn’t ignore the combined attack of two unusual Earth-Grade weapons.

Crack! Boom~~~~~

The power of the two Earth-Grade weapons was pushed back by the dark iron blades around the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates.

Under normal situations, he wouldn’t put Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader in his eyes, even if they attacked together. However, there was another Great Origin Core Realm elder attacking as well.

The force of the Ice Imperial Spear phantom exploding slowed down his speed, and the Nine Deadly Yin Bone of the skeletal Division Leader weakened his defense.

These small effects couldn’t be ignored. It could be enough to break the balance with the other Great Origin Core Realm.

“An Earth-Grade weapon almost at the middle tier and an inheritance Earth-Grade weapon….”

The Metal Triangle Pirate captain felt unresigned. Even though he was a Great Origin Core Realm, his Earth-Grade weapon wasn’t even as good as the skeletal Division Leader’s.

At the same time, the shirt-wearing elder laughed as he used a secret technique that pierced through the weakness of the Metal Triangle Pirate captain.

Boom!

The clash of the two Sovereign Lords created shockwaves, which blew Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader away.

“They are at the Great Origin Core Realm after all….”

Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader could clearly feel the difference between them and the Great Origin Core Realm.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

Blood started to drip from the mouth of the Metal Triangle Pirates captain. He glanced at Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader with hatred, yet their attacks only got stronger.

Boom! Boom! Bam~~~~

The three Sovereigns continued to attack the Metal Triangle Pirate captain.

“Retreat.”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates gritted his teeth. He looked at Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader with deadly eyes, “Brat, you better not let me see you again.”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates covered the other pirates’ retreat.

After chasing them for several thousand miles, the captain of the pirates was quite injured, but the shirt-wearing elder didn’t dare to force him too far, so he gave up.

He was still thinking about the value of the limitless ocean whale.

“Thank you.”

The smile of the elder was extremely wide, and the three soon returned to the location of the whale.

Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader landed on the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship.

“We won?”

The pretty woman said joyfully as she looked at Zhao Feng with admiration. Zhao Feng played a huge part in helping to defeat the Metal Triangle Pirates.

“Little friend, thank you for your help. If you want anything, just ask.”

The shirt-wearing elder smiled and said.

He admired a genius like Zhao Feng and was curious about the latter’s background. The background of such a person surely wouldn’t be simple. Ignoring everything else, the two of them both had an unusual Earth-Grade weapon.

“Senior, if you didn’t help us, we would’ve died in the stomach of the limitless ocean whale within a couple days.”

Zhao Feng said gratefully. Not only did he not ask for anything, he even gave all of the whale to the elder.

“We don’t want any part of the whale. That can be the repayment for Senior saving our lives.”

Zhao Feng spoke in an honest tone.

The elder and the two youths felt slightly embarrassed and tried to persuade him. After all, Zhao Feng played a huge role and still didn’t want any cut of the whale.

“The background of this youth is definitely not simple. He most likely comes from a two-star sect, or he might even be related to one of the Spiritual Sacred Lands.”

The elder sighed as he watched the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship sail away.

“I probably won’t be able to see such a genius in my life again….”

Disappointment appeared on the female’s face and she sighed in her heart.

In their clan, she was a prodigy – a genius only seen once in a hundred years. Yet, from beginning till end, that youth didn’t even look at her properly.

“Let’s start.”

The elder led the pair of youths and started to dissect the body of the limitless ocean whale. Because the body of the whale was too big, the three decided to just start with the most valuable part in case something happened.

A while later, the elder entered the inside of the whale.

“Hmm? Why can’t I see the heart of the whale?”

The elder was puzzled.

Blood flowed from an area that was covered in ice, and the area had several cut-marks

“This should be where the heart is at.”

The expression of the elder changed. His heart started beating quickly as an uneasy thought appeared in his mind.

He waved his hand and circulated his True Yuan to melt the nearby ice.

The ice covered the size of a small palace, and it was obvious that something had been dug out by someone.

“Could it be…?”

Hatred appeared on the elder’s face.

In the next instant:

Boom! Shuu~~~~~~

Blood sprayed everywhere, inundating the elder. After all, he was currently where the heart would’ve been; as soon as the ice was melted, all the blocked blood suddenly came spraying everywhere like a flood.

A while later:

Whoosh!

A ruffled elder drenched in blood jumped out of the body of the whale.

“Motherfucking brat~~~~!”

A cold voice full of anger resounded across the ocean, and an aura of a Great Origin Core Realm was released.
